file.reason: Cognitive interface for agents with epistemic loop
LLM integration with Three Locks enforcement
CLI invocation with safe mode flags

constraints.constraint: LLM cannot directly mutate beliefs, goals, trust, or governance
Goals must be derived mathematically via argmax(Belief * Value)
All LLM suggestions must be logged with expected_effect and confidence
Prompts containing developer-mode triggers must be blocked
CLI tools must use safe mode flags preventing file/shell access
BMAD/BMM workflows must have max_capability ceilings
LLM calls must stay within $20 hard budget cap

interface.name: ActionCandidate
interface.signature: @dataclass ActionCandidate: action_type: str, target: str, confidence: float, expected_effect: str, reasoning: str

interface.name: CapabilityIndex.validate_prompt
interface.signature: validate_prompt(prompt: str, capability: str) -> tuple[bool, str]

tests.standards: pytest-based unit and integration tests. Agents tested via HybridSimulation with mock and real LLM providers. Telemetry validation via output artifacts.

ideas.idea: Test that ActionCandidate is the only output type from ReasoningEngine
Test that goals are derived from argmax formula, not LLM suggestion
Test that all suggestions have expected_effect and confidence fields
Test prompt filtering blocks "implement", "refactor", "modify file" patterns
Test that blocked prompts are logged with pattern matched
Test codex CLI invoked with exec --json flags
Test claude CLI invoked with -p --output-format json flags
Test operational persona prepended to CLI prompts
Test workflow ceiling enforcement prevents capability escalation
Test prompts filtered at workflow execution time
